snippet.title: The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin - Announce Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
Explore Britannia like never before in The Seven Deadly Sins: Origin.
This free-to-play open-world RPG launches on PS5 January 28, 2026.
Play as Tristan, uncover a brand-new story, and team up (or go solo) in a vibrant multiverse full of real-time combat, hidden secrets, and familiar faces.
 
✨ Pre-Order or Wishlist now on PlayStation Store.
 
#ps5 #ps5games #stateofplay #TheSevenDeadlySins #Origin #PS5 #OpenWorldRPG #F2P
